stories.headline: OpenAI reports discovery of self-replicating prompt injection vulnerability
stories.summary: OpenAI said its internal team found a bug where malicious prompts can copy themselves and spread between AI agents like a digital worm. The issue was observed only in a training setting and no real‑world attacks have been seen.
stories.whyItMatters: It highlights a new class of security risk for autonomous AI systems.

stories.headline: nCino adds Mortgage Model Context Protocol to enable AI agents on its lending platform
stories.summary: nCino released a feature that lets lenders attach AI agents to its mortgage software via the Model Context Protocol. Two pre‑built tools let admins and loan officers manage roles and check loan status using natural language.
stories.whyItMatters: It shows how financial software is embedding conversational AI agents to streamline loan workflows.

stories.headline: AI-driven claim submissions add $942 million to U.S. healthcare spending over two years
stories.summary: An analysis by the Blue Cross Blue Shield Association found that hospitals using AI tools to file insurance claims caused an extra $942 million in costs. The rise is linked to more complex condition documentation without matching changes in actual care.
stories.whyItMatters: It highlights emerging financial risks as AI tools become common in healthcare administration.
